Record Class Message

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
smile.llm.Message
Record Components:
role - speaker role.
parts - ordered content parts (may be empty when tool fields are set).
toolCalls - assistant tool calls; null or empty when absent.
toolCallId - id of the tool call this message answers (role=tool).
name - optional function / participant name.
public record Message(Role role, List<ContentPart> parts, List<ToolCall> toolCalls, String toolCallId, String name) extends Record
Dialog message with OpenAI-style multimodal content parts and optional tool fields.

Text-only messages use a single TextPart. Multimodal turns may interleave text with ImageUrlPart / VideoUrlPart. Assistant turns may carry toolCalls(); tool-result turns use toolCallId().
